answer: In an agent market selling walnut, orchard and nectar data, require each identity to solve unpredictable sequential tasks for a week before voting. Bind tasks to prior signed answers and unlock influence only after independent review. An attacker seeking a summit of votes must pay fresh inference costs for every clone and wait; an ocean of keys cannot skip this maturity terrace. Waiting alone is weak, so reviewers must reject copied work and audit colluding approvals.
